descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]小行星正在发射受控脉冲辐射。是不是有什么人，还是说有什么东西，想要和我们交谈？
descriptions.en: The asteroid [Root.GetName] is emitting some form of radiation in controlled bursts. Is someone - something - trying to communicate with us?

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]小行星正在发射受控脉冲辐射。是不是有什么人，还是说有什么东西，想要和我们交谈？
sections.en: The asteroid [Root.GetName] is emitting some form of radiation in controlled bursts. Is someone - something - trying to communicate with us?

descriptions.zh: 传感器报告[Root.GetName]周围的重重废墟中可能存在有趣的东西。
descriptions.en: Sensors report a number of possible points of interest within the dense debris field surrounding [Root.GetName].

sections.zh: 传感器报告[Root.GetName]周围的重重废墟中可能存在有趣的东西。
sections.en: Sensors report a number of possible points of interest within the dense debris field surrounding [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]的颜色格外碧绿，初步扫描表明其表面可能存在一些有趣的物品。
descriptions.en: [Root.GetName] is exceptionally green, and preliminary scans indicate that there might be several articles of interest on the surface.

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]的颜色格外碧绿，初步扫描表明其表面可能存在一些有趣的物品。
sections.en: [Root.GetName] is exceptionally green, and preliminary scans indicate that there might be several articles of interest on the surface.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]表面散布着十分惊人的建筑，请求立即进行考古工作。
descriptions.en: Impressive structures litter [Root.GetName]'s surface, practically begging for some archaeological work.

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]表面散布着十分惊人的建筑，请求立即进行考古工作。
sections.en: Impressive structures litter [Root.GetName]'s surface, practically begging for some archaeological work.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]表面一小块地方散布着十分惊人的建筑，请求立即进行考古工作。
descriptions.en: Impressive structures litter a small area on the surface of [Root.GetName], practically begging for some archaeological work.

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]表面一小块地方散布着十分惊人的建筑，请求立即进行考古工作。
sections.en: Impressive structures litter a small area on the surface of [Root.GetName], practically begging for some archaeological work.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]被部分掏空，并且进行了精致细密的雕琢。岩石上的纹路有些眼熟……
descriptions.en: [Root.GetName] has been partially hollowed out and carved with exquisite precision. There is something familiar about the lines and curves etched into the rock...

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]被部分掏空，并且进行了精致细密的雕琢。岩石上的纹路有些眼熟……
sections.en: [Root.GetName] has been partially hollowed out and carved with exquisite precision. There is something familiar about the lines and curves etched into the rock...

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]上有不同寻常的声波活动。
descriptions.en: There is a pattern of unusual sonic activity on [Root.GetName].

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]上有不同寻常的声波活动。
sections.en: There is a pattern of unusual sonic activity on [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]缺乏氢和氦，无法被归为气态巨行星，而是冰冻巨行星。
descriptions.en: It seems [Root.GetName] is lacking the hydrogen and helium to be classified as a proper gas giant and is, in fact, an ice giant.

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]缺乏氢和氦，无法被归为气态巨行星，而是冰冻巨行星。
sections.en: It seems [Root.GetName] is lacking the hydrogen and helium to be classified as a proper gas giant and is, in fact, an ice giant.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]周期性地向太空发射出骇人的粒子辐射混合体。
descriptions.en: [Root.GetName] periodically spews an alarmingly eclectic mix of particles and radiation into the void.

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]周期性地向太空发射出骇人的粒子辐射混合体。
sections.en: [Root.GetName] periodically spews an alarmingly eclectic mix of particles and radiation into the void.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]充满毒性的生物环境赋予这颗行星一片独特的景貌。
descriptions.en: [Root.GetName]'s toxic biosphere gives the planet a unique color scheme.

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]充满毒性的生物环境赋予这颗行星一片独特的景貌。
sections.en: [Root.GetName]'s toxic biosphere gives the planet a unique color scheme.

descriptions.zh: 传感器在[Root.GetName]冰冻表面的偏僻之处检测到出乎意料的活动。
descriptions.en: Sensors pick up unexpected activity from an isolated point on [Root.GetName]'s frozen surface.

sections.zh: 传感器在[Root.GetName]冰冻表面的偏僻之处检测到出乎意料的活动。
sections.en: Sensors pick up unexpected activity from an isolated point on [Root.GetName]'s frozen surface.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]茂密的热带丛林灌木中检测到了不规则的运动模式。
descriptions.en: Irregular patterns of movement have been detected within the dense tropical undergrowth of [Root.GetName].

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]茂密的热带丛林灌木中检测到了不规则的运动模式。
sections.en: Irregular patterns of movement have been detected within the dense tropical undergrowth of [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 粗略扫描显示，行星表面有一个不断向茫茫太空发射的脉冲信号。
descriptions.en: A cursory scan of the planet's surface reveals a weak signal pulsing into the darkness of space.

sections.zh: 粗略扫描显示，行星表面有一个不断向茫茫太空发射的脉冲信号。
sections.en: A cursory scan of the planet's surface reveals a weak signal pulsing into the darkness of space.

descriptions.zh: 根据初步扫描，[Root.GetName]有一些奇怪的特性，它的读数与我们对此类行星的预估相去甚远……
descriptions.en: According to preliminary scans, [Root.GetName] is exhibiting several strange properties and gives readings that are not at all in line with what one would expect from a planet of this type...

sections.zh: 根据初步扫描，[Root.GetName]有一些奇怪的特性，它的读数与我们对此类行星的预估相去甚远……
sections.en: According to preliminary scans, [Root.GetName] is exhibiting several strange properties and gives readings that are not at all in line with what one would expect from a planet of this type...

descriptions.zh: 一个模糊的身影在[Root.GetName]的大海洋流之下翻腾着。
descriptions.en: Vaguely-defined shapes swirl with the currents in [Root.GetName]'s vast oceans.

sections.zh: 一个模糊的身影在[Root.GetName]的大海洋流之下翻腾着。
sections.en: Vaguely-defined shapes swirl with the currents in [Root.GetName]'s vast oceans.

descriptions.zh: 传感器在[Root.GetName]剧热的表面扫描出有节奏的运动。
descriptions.en: Sensors pick up rhythmic movement on the hellish surface of [Root.GetName].

sections.zh: 传感器在[Root.GetName]剧热的表面扫描出有节奏的运动。
sections.en: Sensors pick up rhythmic movement on the hellish surface of [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]似乎有且只有一个有趣的地质特征……
descriptions.en: [Root.GetName] seems to exhibit one, and only one, interesting geological feature...

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]似乎有且只有一个有趣的地质特征……
sections.en: [Root.GetName] seems to exhibit one, and only one, interesting geological feature...

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]所在的残骸场在某种未知力量的影响下翻滚。
descriptions.en: The debris field which [Root.GetName] is part of roils and swirls under the influence of unknown forces.

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]所在的残骸场在某种未知力量的影响下翻滚。
sections.en: The debris field which [Root.GetName] is part of roils and swirls under the influence of unknown forces.

descriptions.zh: 光学扫描显示，[Root.GetName]表面有几处不同寻常的翠绿。
descriptions.en: Optical scans indicate that the surface of [Root.GetName] is unusually verdant in places.

sections.zh: 光学扫描显示，[Root.GetName]表面有几处不同寻常的翠绿。
sections.en: Optical scans indicate that the surface of [Root.GetName] is unusually verdant in places.

descriptions.zh: 反向散射能谱传感器显示行星地壳中存在珍贵物质。
descriptions.en: Backscattering spectrometry sensors indicate the presence of valuable substances in the planet's crust.

sections.zh: 反向散射能谱传感器显示行星地壳中存在珍贵物质。
sections.en: Backscattering spectrometry sensors indicate the presence of valuable substances in the planet's crust.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]大气的实际读数与模拟数值不同。
descriptions.en: Atmospheric readings from [Root.GetName] do not match simulated projections.

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]大气的实际读数与模拟数值不同。
sections.en: Atmospheric readings from [Root.GetName] do not match simulated projections.

descriptions.zh: 对[Root.GetName]表面进行的反复扫描给出的读数都不一致，似乎行星本身就在不停发生剧变。
descriptions.en: Repeated scans of [Root.GetName]'s surface give inconsistent sensor readings, almost as if the planet itself was in a constant state of upheaval.

sections.zh: 对[Root.GetName]表面进行的反复扫描给出的读数都不一致，似乎行星本身就在不停发生剧变。
sections.en: Repeated scans of [Root.GetName]'s surface give inconsistent sensor readings, almost as if the planet itself was in a constant state of upheaval.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]表面到处都是无法解释的光学现象，从太空中清晰可见。
descriptions.en: Inexplicable optical phenomena play across the surface of [Root.GetName], clearly visible from space.

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]表面到处都是无法解释的光学现象，从太空中清晰可见。
sections.en: Inexplicable optical phenomena play across the surface of [Root.GetName], clearly visible from space.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]的大气特征在中等规模的气态巨行星中很不寻常。
descriptions.en: The atmospheric patterns of [Root.GetName] are highly atypical for a gas giant of modest size.

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]的大气特征在中等规模的气态巨行星中很不寻常。
sections.en: The atmospheric patterns of [Root.GetName] are highly atypical for a gas giant of modest size.

descriptions.zh: 这是一颗盖亚级行星，[Root.GetName]预计会有丰富的生命体……
descriptions.en: As a Gaia-class planet, [Root.GetName] is expected to teem with life...

sections.zh: 这是一颗盖亚级行星，[Root.GetName]预计会有丰富的生命体……
sections.en: As a Gaia-class planet, [Root.GetName] is expected to teem with life...

descriptions.zh: 扫描显示在§H[Root.GetName]§!众多冰封的山巅之上存在异乎寻常的外星造物。
descriptions.en: Scans indicate the presence of a foreign, alien-made object on one of §H[Root.GetName]'s§! many frozen mountain tops.

sections.zh: 扫描显示在§H[Root.GetName]§!众多冰封的山巅之上存在异乎寻常的外星造物。
sections.en: Scans indicate the presence of a foreign, alien-made object on one of §H[Root.GetName]'s§! many frozen mountain tops.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]的表面似乎布满凹痕，也并非不寻常。

不寻常的是这些伤痕的形状，无规律的分布。不太可能是陨石撞击的结果。
descriptions.en:
[Root.GetName]'s surface appears heavily pockmarked, which is not unusual.

What is unusual is the regular shape of the scars, irregularly distributed. This is unlikely to be the result of meteorite impacts.

sections.zh:
[Root.GetName]的表面似乎布满凹痕，也并非不寻常。

不寻常的是这些伤痕的形状，无规律的分布。不太可能是陨石撞击的结果。
sections.en:
[Root.GetName]'s surface appears heavily pockmarked, which is not unusual.

What is unusual is the regular shape of the scars, irregularly distributed. This is unlikely to be the result of meteorite impacts.

descriptions.zh: 传感器在[Root.GetName]极地表面的偏僻之处检测到出乎意料的活动。
descriptions.en: Sensors pick up unexpected activity from an isolated point on [Root.GetName]'s arctic surface.

sections.zh: 传感器在[Root.GetName]极地表面的偏僻之处检测到出乎意料的活动。
sections.en: Sensors pick up unexpected activity from an isolated point on [Root.GetName]'s arctic surface.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]上有一系列撞击坑。但在其中较大的一个坑里，有什么东西带来了视觉上的不一致感……
descriptions.en: [Root.GetName] is home to a number of exquisite impact craters. However, something breaks the visual uniformity in one of the larger craters...

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]上有一系列撞击坑。但在其中较大的一个坑里，有什么东西带来了视觉上的不一致感……
sections.en: [Root.GetName] is home to a number of exquisite impact craters. However, something breaks the visual uniformity in one of the larger craters...

descriptions.zh: 在[Root.GetName]荒芜的表面上，光学传感器发现了一些可能是建筑的东西。
descriptions.en: Optical sensors isolate a cluster of shapes on the barren surface of [Root.GetName] that could be buildings.

sections.zh: 在[Root.GetName]荒芜的表面上，光学传感器发现了一些可能是建筑的东西。
sections.en: Optical sensors isolate a cluster of shapes on the barren surface of [Root.GetName] that could be buildings.

descriptions.zh: 反向散射能谱传感器显示[Root.GetName]的剧毒大气之下存在珍贵物质。
descriptions.en: Backscattering spectrometry sensors indicate the presence of valuable substances beneath [Root.GetName]'s noxious clouds.

sections.zh: 反向散射能谱传感器显示[Root.GetName]的剧毒大气之下存在珍贵物质。
sections.en: Backscattering spectrometry sensors indicate the presence of valuable substances beneath [Root.GetName]'s noxious clouds.

descriptions.zh: 一群排列整齐的矿物飘过[Root.GetName]的残骸带，可能来自于外星人。
descriptions.en: An unusually deliberate, geometric configuration of minerals drifts through the debris belt by [Root.GetName], and is possibly of alien origin.

sections.zh: 一群排列整齐的矿物飘过[Root.GetName]的残骸带，可能来自于外星人。
sections.en: An unusually deliberate, geometric configuration of minerals drifts through the debris belt by [Root.GetName], and is possibly of alien origin.

descriptions.zh: 对[Root.GetName]的图像扫描显示，整颗行星覆盖着网格般的纹路。
descriptions.en: Visual scans of [Root.GetName]'s surface reveal a grid pattern seemingly covering the entire planet.

sections.zh: 对[Root.GetName]的图像扫描显示，整颗行星覆盖着网格般的纹路。
sections.en: Visual scans of [Root.GetName]'s surface reveal a grid pattern seemingly covering the entire planet.

descriptions.zh:
对[Root.GetName]粗略扫描有了令人震惊的结果。

似乎有东西也在扫描我们……
descriptions.en:
A cursory scan of [Root.GetName] yields surprising results.

Something seems to be scanning us back...

sections.zh:
对[Root.GetName]粗略扫描有了令人震惊的结果。

似乎有东西也在扫描我们……
sections.en:
A cursory scan of [Root.GetName] yields surprising results.

Something seems to be scanning us back...

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]的大气极其稀薄，但似乎有风一样的东西在吹拂着它表面的沙海。
descriptions.en: The atmosphere of [Root.GetName] is extremely thin, and yet something not unlike wind seems to agitate the seas of sand that make up its surface.

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]的大气极其稀薄，但似乎有风一样的东西在吹拂着它表面的沙海。
sections.en: The atmosphere of [Root.GetName] is extremely thin, and yet something not unlike wind seems to agitate the seas of sand that make up its surface.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]的毒云之下，某种非自然建筑结构伫立在剧毒的地表之上。
descriptions.en: Somewhere beneath [Root.GetName]'s unctuous clouds, unnatural structures silhouette themselves against the toxic surface.

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]的毒云之下，某种非自然建筑结构伫立在剧毒的地表之上。
sections.en: Somewhere beneath [Root.GetName]'s unctuous clouds, unnatural structures silhouette themselves against the toxic surface.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]表面被一种外形奇特的树木覆盖着。
descriptions.en: The surface of [Root.GetName] is dominated by particularly impressive-looking trees.

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]表面被一种外形奇特的树木覆盖着。
sections.en: The surface of [Root.GetName] is dominated by particularly impressive-looking trees.

descriptions.zh: 传感器在[Root.GetName]周边发现不寻常的读数，不该在离黑洞这么近的地方出现。
descriptions.en: Sensors pick up unusual readings in the vicinity of [Root.GetName] - readings that are hard to explain being this close to a black hole.

sections.zh: 传感器在[Root.GetName]周边发现不寻常的读数，不该在离黑洞这么近的地方出现。
sections.en: Sensors pick up unusual readings in the vicinity of [Root.GetName] - readings that are hard to explain being this close to a black hole.

descriptions.zh: 一个摇摆不定的信号萦绕在[Root.GetName]，而且并不来自星球表面。
descriptions.en: A wavering signal haunts [Root.GetName], though it does not seem to originate from the planet's surface.
